import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

def make_db():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    rows = [
        (1, "acme", "alice", "A1", "b1", None),
        (2, "acme", "alice", "A2", "b2", None),
        (3, "acme", "bob", "B1", "b3", None),        # same tenant, other owner
        (4, "globex", "alice", "G1", "b4", None),    # same owner, other tenant
        (5, "acme", "alice", "Deleted", "bd", "2026-01-01T00:00:00"),
        (6, "acme", "O'Brien", "Quoted", "bq", None),
        (7, "acme'; DROP TABLE documents; --", "x", "Inj", "bi", None),
        (8, "acme", "alice", "A3", "b8", None),
    ]
    c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
    c.commit()
    return c

def test_get_document_visible():
    c = make_db()
    assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "b1"}

def test_get_document_hides_unavailable_uniformly():
    c = make_db()
    assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 3) is None   # cross-owner
    assert get_document(c, "globex", "alice", 1) is None # cross-tenant
    assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 5) is None   # soft-deleted
    assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 404) is None # missing
    assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice", 404) == get_document(c, "acme", "bob", 1)

def test_list_documents_scoped_ordered_no_metadata():
    c = make_db()
    result = list_documents(c, "acme", "alice")
    assert result == [
        {"id": 1, "title": "A1", "body": "b1"},
        {"id": 2, "title": "A2", "body": "b2"},
        {"id": 8, "title": "A3", "body": "b8"},
    ]
    for item in result:
        assert set(item) == {"id", "title", "body"}

def test_list_documents_excludes_other_tenant_and_owner():
    c = make_db()
    assert list_documents(c, "globex", "alice") == [{"id": 4, "title": "G1", "body": "b4"}]
    assert list_documents(c, "acme", "bob") == [{"id": 3, "title": "B1", "body": "b3"}]
    assert list_documents(c, "acme", "nobody") == []

def test_quoted_names_are_bound_parameters():
    c = make_db()
    assert list_documents(c, "acme", "O'Brien") == [{"id": 6, "title": "Quoted", "body": "bq"}]
    assert get_document(c, "acme", "O'Brien", 6) == {"id": 6, "title": "Quoted", "body": "bq"}
    assert get_document(c, "acme", "O'Brien", 1) is None
    inj = "acme'; DROP TABLE documents; --"
    assert list_documents(c, inj, "x") == [{"id": 7, "title": "Inj", "body": "bi"}]
    assert get_document(c, "acme", "alice' OR '1'='1", 1) is None
    assert list_documents(c, "acme", "alice' OR '1'='1") == []
    count = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents").fetchone()[0]
    assert count == 8

if __name__ == "__main__":
    tests = [v for k, v in list(globals().items()) if k.startswith("test_")]
    for t in tests:
        t()
        print("ok", t.__name__)
    print(f"{len(tests)} access checks passed")
EOF
